question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Be all ears
solution:
The correct answer is- **'Eager to listen****'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'****Be all ears​​' **is 'Eager to listen'.
 
• Let’s look at the meaning and example of the given phrasal verb:
 
 
• Be all ears- "Eager to hear something, listening attentively" (कुछ सुनने को आतुर, ध्यान से सुनना)
 
 
• *E.g. Everyone on the plane was** all ears **when the pilot said we had to make an emergency landing.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​*Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 3rd option is the correct choice.
